purpose: Offline NASA global Mars topography (MGS MOLA MEGDR 4ppd) and surface color mosaic (Viking MDIM 2.1) for demo spherical 3D globe

sources.name: NASA MGS MOLA MEGDR 4ppd Global Topography (MEGT90N000CB.IMG)
